# Fast. Free. Full‑featured.

Obsidian Mobile is your second brain on the go. Available for free on
iOS and Android.

[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)
App
Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/obsidian-connected-notes/id1557175442)
[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)
Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=md.obsidian)

![Obsidian on iPad Pro](/images/screenshot-tablet-1.png)

## Feel at home

Obsidian Mobile brings the power of our desktop app to your
mobile devices.

Tabs, Command Palette, plugins, custom hotkeys — everything that makes
Obsidian great is here. Stay productive without another learning curve.

![Obsidian on iPad Pro](/images/screenshot-tablet-3.png)

## Small yet mighty

Obsidian’s best features work out of the box. Core plugins, including
graph view, work the same. Even better, community plugins are just a few
taps away to supercharge your workflow.

![Obsidian on iPad Pro](/images/screenshot-tablet-4.png)

## Speed of thought

Obsidian Mobile is blazing fast, so you can jot things down before you
forget them.

With the customizable toolbar and touch-friendly gestures, zip around
your second brain with ease.

![Obsidian on iPad Pro](/images/screenshot-tablet-2.png)
